finding.title: AC-C5 and AC-0.3 use `grep -E '^-[^-]'`, which does not detect a deleted markdown bullet, so "edits are additive" is not proved
finding.wrong_outcome: An implementer who follows AC-C5 builds a gate that prints nothing and passes when a phase deletes an existing "Will Not" bullet or an approval-gate bullet from a command file, and that is wrong because AC-C5 is the spec's only mechanical proof that standalone behaviour (SA-1) and safety lines are untouched. (AC-0.3 is safe in practice because routing rows start with `|`; AC-C5 is not.)
